mark_breakdown.desc: Correct five-number summary read from site 1 boxplot

subparts.solution:
The five-number summary for site 1 is:
$\text{minimum} = 15$, $Q_1 = 30$, $\text{median} = 50$, $Q_3 = 60$, $\text{maximum} = 70$

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Read the five key values (whisker ends, box edges, and central line) from the boxplot for site 1.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Misreading the scale on the vertical axis.

subparts.solution: Site 3 has the greatest range of weights.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Range is the overall length from the end of the lower whisker to the end of the upper whisker.
step_by_step: Observe overall spread for each site: Site 1 runs from 15 to 70 (range = 55). Site 2 runs from about 10 to 55 (range = 45). Site 3 runs from about 5 to 75 (range = 70).
Site 3 has the largest overall whisker-to-whisker span.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Looking only at the length of the box (IQR) instead of total range.
